question: Assume today is 2026-10-27. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate Equinor's total equity liquids and gas production in the third quarter of 2026, in barrels of oil equivalent per day (the report states it in thousand boe per day, mboe/d), as it will be first reported in Equinor's third quarter 2026 financial statements and review.

target.what: Equinor ASA's total equity production of liquids and gas, i.e. the 'Total equity production' line reported in Equinor's third-quarter 2026 financial statements and review, summing all liquids and gas volumes at Equinor's equity share worldwide. Working interpretation: equity production, not entitlem
target.unit: thousand barrels of oil equivalent per day (mboe/d)
target.caveats: The target period is completed relative to 2026-10-27, but the Q3 2026 report may not yet have been published at the cutoff; any estimate must be ex ante. 'Total equity production' can differ materially from entitlement production because of fiscal terms. The definition may include NGL/condensate/ot

candidates.hypothesis: Equinor's own quarterly equity production history and Q3 seasonality provide the primary prior; recent Q1-Q2 2026 levels and Q3 values in earlier years constrain the likely Q3 2026 total after adjusting for portfolio changes and maintenance.
candidates.data_to_find: Equinor quarterly 'Total equity production' in mboe/d and liquids/gas split for Q3 2023, Q3 2024, Q3 2025, and Q1-Q2 2026, plus any monthly or quarterly production updates published before 2026-10-27. Minimum evidence: same-quarter history and the most recent quarters before cutoff. Substitute: annual production and quarterly trend if exact Q3 tables are unavailable.

candidates.hypothesis: Equinor's international equity production can be built from host-country field production and Equinor equity shares; key countries include Brazil, UK, US Gulf of Mexico, Angola/Azerbaijan/Canada as relevant.
candidates.data_to_find: Q3 2026 field-level production from ANP Brazil, NSTA UK, BOEM/BSEE US Gulf of Mexico, and other host regulators; Equinor equity shares by field; partner production updates. Minimum evidence: production for Equinor's largest international fields and equity shares. Substitute: partner company Q3 2026 production reports if regulator data lag.

candidates.hypothesis: Q3 2026 production equals available capacity minus planned turnarounds and unplanned outages plus ramp-up from new fields; maintenance and outage exposure in Q3 2026 is a major source of deviation from recent quarterly levels.
candidates.data_to_find: Equinor maintenance schedules and outage notices for Q3 2026; curtailments at Johan Sverdrup, Troll, Snøhvit, Gullfaks, Oseberg, Johan Castberg, Bacalhau and international assets; first oil and ramp profiles for new fields. Minimum evidence: dated outage or maintenance events with estimated duration and affected capacity. Substitute: trade press and partner reports if operator notices are unavailable.

candidates.hypothesis: A bottom-up sum over major assets of nameplate capacity times realised uptime times Equinor equity share, plus an allowance for smaller fields, can approximate total equity production.
candidates.data_to_find: Nameplate or plateau capacity for Equinor's major fields, Equinor equity shares, expected Q3 2026 uptime, ramp-up profiles for new fields, and planned turnaround duration. Minimum evidence: capacities and equity shares for assets covering most of Equinor's production. Substitute: field-level historical production as a proxy for realised capacity.
search_hints: Equinor major assets production capacity mboe/d

candidates.hypothesis: Equinor's 2026 production guidance and analyst consensus for Q3 2026 provide an independent prior, though guidance is not realised production and may be defined differently.
candidates.data_to_find: Equinor 2026 production guidance or growth target, Q3 2026 production consensus estimates, quarterly forecasts from analysts, and any company update before 2026-10-27. Minimum evidence: a Q3 2026 total or growth rate and the definition used. Substitute: annual guidance plus quarterly seasonality if Q3 consensus is unavailable.

candidates.hypothesis: Partner companies' Q3 2026 production updates and stock-exchange announcements before cutoff may disclose field-level volumes or disruptions that adjust the top-down estimate.
candidates.data_to_find: Q3 2026 production updates from Equinor's partners (e.g. Aker BP, Vår Energi, Shell, TotalEnergies, Petrobras where relevant), field partner reports, and Norwegian petroleum register ownership data. Minimum evidence: production or outage disclosure for fields material to Equinor. Substitute: partner monthly production reports if quarterly reports are not yet published.

candidates.hypothesis: A consistent bridge from field-level oil, NGL/condensate and gas volumes to boe/d and from gross to equity share is needed; errors in conversion or equity treatment can materially change the total.
candidates.data_to_find: Equinor's boe conversion factors, gas-to-boe convention, treatment of NGL/condensate, equity vs entitlement definitions, and field equity shares. Minimum evidence: Equinor's stated conversion basis and equity-share methodology. Substitute: standard industry conversion if Equinor's exact convention is unavailable, with caveat.

assumptions.applies_when: Q3 2026 headwinds are broadly as identified and no major unplanned outage occurs beyond those evidence points.
assumptions.falsified_by: Q3 2026 production updates showing YoY growth clearly above 4% or below -3%.

assumptions.name: Q3 2026 adjustment to Q3/Q2 2025 seasonal ratio
assumptions.rationale: The Q3/Q2 2025 ratio captures normal seasonality, including normal maintenance. Q3 2026 explicit incremental headwinds total roughly 49 kboe/d: Castberg 14 kbpd (p95), third-party operated fields 10 kboe/d (p435), and US offshore 25 kboe/d (p437). Against Q2 2026 production of 2165 mboe/d this is about 2.3%, hence a factor near 0.98. New fields and possible lower other maintenance could offset some of this, so the high end is slightly above 1.
assumptions.applies_when: The listed Q3 2026 reductions are incremental to the normal Q3/Q2 seasonal pattern rather than already fully reflected in the 2025 ratio.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that the listed reductions are already embedded in the Q3/Q2 2025 seasonal pattern, or that large new-field ramp-ups more than offset them.

assumptions.applies_when: Q3 2026 headwinds affect liquids and gas roughly proportionally, and the 2025 Q3/Q2 liquids and gas seasonal ratios remain directionally useful.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that Q3 2026 reductions are concentrated in one stream or that liquids/gas seasonal ratios differ materially from 2025.

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
